title: Score is not 100 x ID x weight x quantity
why: confidence_score must equal the product of its three factors.

title: Weight score does not match the Comext route
why: PST/PA 0.6 or 0.4, converted 0.5 or 0.4, price proxy 0.3.

title: Emissions approach contradicts the weight source
why: COMEXT rows need a Comext or price-proxy weight; research-derived rows must not have one.

title: Total kg is not units x kg per unit
why: total_kg_est must equal units_est x kg_per_unit (rounding allowed).

title: Price-proxy total kg is not value x FX / EUR per kg
why: For the price proxy the quantity cancels out; a difference means the order value was counted twice.

title: Production basis contradicts the manufacturing category
why: Weight-based needs category A or B, a production recipe and a weight; the total must equal the chosen method.

title: Cradle-to-gate columns do not match the chosen method
why: Total must equal the weight- or spend-based figure for the row's method (blank only when unallocated); unit x units must equal the total.

title: Weight-based and spend-based differ more than 5x
why: Usually a wrong recipe, a wrong weight or a wrong spend sector.

title: WFP price per kg is 0.2-5x off Comext
why: Usually the wrong CN8 within the 6-digit code, or a quantity in another unit.

title: Price per kg far from the item's own median
why: The quantity may be in kg, m, m2 or pallets rather than pieces.

title: Quantity 1 with a large value
why: Units were re-estimated from the item's typical unit price.

title: One row carries over 2% of all estimated kg
why: Large single contributions are where magnitude errors hide.

title: Implied price below $0.05/kg or above $2,000/kg
why: Physically unlikely for goods; check the quantity and the weight.

title: Goods or kit without a kg per unit
why: These fall back to spend-based factors.

title: Item inferred from a fallback match or the material group
why: The description did not match on its head noun; check the item.

title: Weight is per pair but the text does not say pairs
why: Footwear and gloves: the quantity may count single items.

title: Quantity is not a whole number
why: Usually m2, m or kg rather than pieces.

title: Comext spread is wide (p75/p25 > 3)
why: The median is used but the item type varies a lot within the code.

title: Catch-all item (tent unspecified, other kit)
why: Identification is capped at 0.6.

title: Weight is an Unqualified Estimate
why: No published source for this weight.

title: Weight-based with a labelled proxy material factor
why: See material_factors.csv for the proxy and its direction (over- or understates).

title: Spend-based goods bought from a re-export hub
why: The supplier country may not be where the goods were made.
